# End-of-Season Checklist

A short list to run through before packing the feeders away for winter.

- Clean every feeder with a diluted vinegar rinse and let it dry fully.
- Check the pole and hooks for rust before storing them.
- Photograph the yard from the porch steps, the same angle as last year.
- Copy any loose notes into this guide before they get lost over winter.

None of this takes more than an afternoon, and skipping it usually means
starting the next season a week behind.
